Requirements: Must be in possession of a qualification from an educational institution, at MQF Level 6 or equivalent, in any Information Technology or Engineering related area of study. Key Expert 2 – Project Manager Role: This Key Expert must oversee technology-focused initiatives, and ensure they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality. Asendav meeskonnaliige peab vastama vähemalt samadele nõuetele, mis olid esitatud asendatavale liikmele. Kogu projektiga seotud suhtlus, dokumentatsioon ja aruandlus peavad toimuma eesti keeles. Lisaks pakkumuses nimetatud meeskonna liikmetele võib tekkida vajadus kaasata hankelepingu täitmisel täiendavaid spetsialiste. Revenue requires a platform for 200 users that provides access to relevant, high -quality learning content on current technologies and industry practices. The platform should have a clear, intuitive catalogue that enables users to easily search for and access relevant learning materia ls. The provider must ensure that content is regularly reviewed and updated to reflect developments in technology and industry practices. Awarding a contract based on best value for money means that the contract shall be awarded to the “most economically advantageous tender((MEAT)”. Therefore, value may imply more than just price; quality issues also need to be addressed. Best value for money is one of the main principles to be fully considered by the FPA and SGA. 6. Competition Procurement procedures are to be opened up to competition. Therefore, contracting authorities may not use procurement procedures in such a way as to prevent, restrict, distort or artificially narrow competition. Competition is a key requirement for ensuring compliance with the best value for money principle, the g reater the competition, the better the chances to have lower price and higher value. Reference No.:  JO-MOE-566807-CS-INDV

Program Background:

The Modernizing Education, Skills, and Administrative Reforms (MASAR) Program for Results (PforR) is a transformative, system-wide reform initiative anchored in Jordan’s Economic Modernization Vision (EMV). The MASAR Operation is designed to support the Ministry of Education and Human Resources Development in addressing foundational bottlenecks in access, quality, and relevance of education, with a dual emphasis on equity and efficiency. MASAR is structured around four interlinked Results Areas (RAs) that are strategically aligned with key education-sector transition points and cross-cutting governance reforms:

  • RA1: Home to School – Expanding Access to Foundational Learning. This includes (i) increasing equitable access to KG2, particularly in under-served districts and refugee-hosting communities; (ii) enhancing the quality of early childhood education through a revised KG1-KG2 curriculum and quality assurance mechanisms; and (iii) improving foundational literacy skills for Grades 1–3 through targeted pedagogical interventions and a comprehensive implementation plan.
  • RA2: School to Work – Increasing Access to Labor Market-Relevant TVET. MASAR seeks to improve the alignment of TVET with private sector needs by institutionalizing public-private partnerships, scaling apprenticeships, and expanding career guidance and employment pathways. All Key Experts are required to: • Ensure continuity of service during absences, leave, or unavailability • Facilitate structured information sharing and operational resilience • Support audit, compliance, and quality assurance requirements • Reduce dependency on a single individual Key Expert 1 – Infrastructure Solutions Architect Role: The Key Expert shall design and manag e server, network, storage, virtualisation, cloud, cybersecurity, and ICT infrastructure solutions. This Key Expert must be fluent in Maltese and/or English and capable of facilitating meetings when needed. Requirements: Must be in possession of a qualification from an educational institution, at MQF Level 6 or equivalent, in any Information Technology or Engineering related area of study. Key Expert 2 – Project Manager Role: This Key Expert must oversee technology-focused initiatives, and ensure they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality. Requirements: The proposed Project Manager must hold a recognised Project Management certification, such as PRINC

Testija: vastutab kvaliteedikontrolli ja testimise eest (võib olla kombineeritud disaineri või projektijuhi rolliga). Pakkuja peab pakkumises esitama meeskonnaliikmete nimed ja rollid ning iga rolli kohta CV Lisa 6 vormil. Meeskonnaliikmeid võib hankelepingu täitmise ajal vahetada, kuid sellest tuleb hankijat eelnevalt teavitada. Asendav meeskonnaliige peab vastama vähemalt samadele nõuetele, mis olid esitatud asendatavale liikmele. Kogu projektiga seotud suhtlus, dokumentatsioon ja aruandlus peavad toimuma eesti keeles. Lähtekoodi kommentaarid ja tehniline dokumentatsioon koostatakse inglise keeles. Lisaks pakkumuses nimetatud meeskonna liikmetele võib tekkida vajadus kaasata hankelepingu täitmisel täiendavaid spetsialiste. Isikuandmete töötlemine riigihanke käigus Hankija kogub ja töötleb riigihanke läbiviimise käigus isikuandmeid vastavalt Euroopa Parlamendi ja nõukogu määrusele (EL) 2016/679 füüsiliste isikute kaitse kohta isikuandmete töötlemisel ja selliste andmete vaba liikumise ning direktiivi 95/46/EÜ kehtetuks tunnistamise kohta (isikuandmete kaitse üldmäärus, edaspidi GDPR). Isikuandmete töötlemise eesmärk on hankemenetluse läbiviimine, sealhulgas pakkumuste hindamine, kvalifikatsiooninõuete kontroll, hankelepingu sõlmimise ja täitmisega seotud toimingud ning riigihanke läbipaistvuse, aruandluse ja kontrolli tagamine, sealhulgas seoses struktuurivahendite kasutamisest tingitud auditeerimise ja järelevalvega. Pakkumuses esitatud isikuandmeid ei kasutata automatiseeritud otsuste tegemiseks ega profiilianalüüsiks. Isikuandmete töötlemise õiguslik alus on RHS-ist tulenev hankija õiguslik kohustus ning GDPR artikli 6 lõike 1 punkt c. entity_geography.text: Performance Successful performance will be an essential feature of work awarded under the Panel. Poor performance will be identified and raised with panel members and may result in termination of a contract and/or removal from the panel. Evaluation Criteria for Admittance to the Panel Application Requirements The Contracting Authority is using a process similar to the OPEN procedure for the establishment of this panel, therefore, while all interested parties may apply, only those demonstrating that they have the required level of qualifications, experience and technical capacity will have their application considered. In order to demonstrate eligibility, applicants are required to provide the following information: General Information Including the following information: Name of applicant Address Key contact name Key contact email Key contact phone / mobile Website if applicable Other social media platform activities Date of establishment Insurance Requirements Confirmation of insurances in place and commitment to put the following levels in place if successful for the contract: Must provide evidence of this level of cover being in place or a letter from an Insurance company stating that these levels of cover may be put in place if a contract is awarded within one week of the appointment

Use of the Panel The Contracting Authority will use this panel as and when requirements within its scope arise.
